init_policies: initialize LiteLLM policy engine with policy config, attachments, and optional database validation
init_policies_sync: run policy initialization synchronously without database validation or async event loop
get_policies_summary: get a summary of loaded policies and attachments for debugging and display
validate_policies_config: validate policy configuration against guardrail and team key existence rules
load_policy_attachments: load policy attachment configurations into the global attachment registry
